verdict.rationale: Pricing models are a fair question for a hosted search service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no published per-unit pricing by searches, records, or nodes. Pricing-page items list only plan features and a 14-day trial, and one community report mentions a flat $1200/month next tier. That is a plan price, not per-unit metering that would let a founder predict cost.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing (searches, records, or nodes) lets me predict what search will cost before committing
